lines: Attano ajjhāsayānurūpaṃ dutiyagāthāya vuttāya sulasā ṭhānuppattikāraṇaṃ paṭilabhitvā “ayaṃ coro mayhaṃ jīvitaṃ na dassati, upāyena naṃ paṭhamataraṃ papāte pātetvā jīvitakkhayaṃ pāpessāmī”ti cintetvā gāthādvayamāha – 20.
Na cāhaṃ abhijānāmi, aññaṃ piyataraṃ tayā. 21.
Na hi dāni puna atthi, mama tuyhañca saṅgamo”ti.
Sattuko tassādhippāyaṃ ajānanto “sādhu, bhadde, ehi upagūhassu ma”nti āha.

Sulasā taṃ tikkhattuṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā upagūhitvā “idāni taṃ, sāmi, catūsu passesu vandissāmī”ti vatvā pādapiṭṭhiyaṃ sīsaṃ ṭhapetvā bāhupasse vanditvā pacchimapassaṃ gantvā vandamānā viya hutvā nāgabalā gaṇikā coraṃ dvīsu pacchāpādesu gahetvā heṭṭhā sīsaṃ katvā sataporise narake khipi.
Taṃ kiriyaṃ disvā pabbatamatthake nibbattadevatā imā gāthā abhāsi – 22.
“Na hi sabbesu ṭhānesu, puriso hoti paṇḍito;
Itthīpi paṇḍitā hoti, tattha tattha vicakkhaṇā. 23.
“Na hi sabbesu ṭhānesu, puriso hoti paṇḍito;
Itthīpi paṇḍitā hoti, lahuṃ atthaṃ vicintikā. 24.
Tattha paṇḍitā hotīti itthīpi paṇḍitā tattha tattha vicakkhaṇā hoti, atha vā itthī paṇḍitā ceva tattha tattha vicakkhaṇā ca hoti.
Lahuṃ atthaṃ vicintikāti lahuṃ khippaṃ atthaṃ vicintikā.
Nikaṭṭhe samacetayīti santike ṭhitāva tassa maraṇūpāyaṃ cintesi.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – yathā cheko migaluddako sakaṇḍapuṇṇadhanusmiṃ khippaṃ migaṃ vadhati, evaṃ sulasā sattukaṃ vadhīti.
Sattukāmivāti sattukā iva, yathā sulasā muttā, evaṃ muccatīti attho.

after.title: [419] 3. Sulasājātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Iti sulasā coraṃ vadhitvā pabbatā oruyha attano parijanassa santikaṃ gantvā “ayyaputto kaha”nti puṭṭhā “mā taṃ pucchathā”ti vatvā rathaṃ abhiruhitvā nagarameva pāvisi.

after.title: [419] 3. Sulasājātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Satthā imaṃ dhammadesanaṃ āharitvā jātakaṃ samodhānesi “tadā te ubhopi imeyeva ahesuṃ, devatā pana ahameva ahosi”nti.

after.title: [420] 4. Sumaṅgalajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Bhusamhi kuddhoti idaṃ satthā jetavane viharanto rājovādasuttaṃ ārabbha kathesi.
Tadā pana satthā raññā yācito atītaṃ āhari.

after.title: [420] 4. Sumaṅgalajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Atīte bārāṇasiyaṃ brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto tassa aggamahesiyā kucchimhi nibbatto vayappatto pitu accayena rajjaṃ kāresi, mahādānaṃ pavattesi.
Atheko paccekabuddho nandamūlakapabbhārā nikkhamitvā cārikaṃ caramāno bārāṇasiṃ patvā uyyāne vasitvā punadivase nagaraṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.

Tamenaṃ rājā disvā pasannacitto vanditvā pāsādaṃ āropetvā rājāsane nisīdāpetvā nānaggarasehi khādanīyabhojanīyehi parivisitvā anumodanaṃ sutvā pasanno attano uyyāne vasanatthāya paṭiññaṃ gāhāpetvā uyyānaṃ pavesetvā sayampi bhuttapātarāso tattha gantvā rattiṭṭhānadivāṭṭhānādīni saṃvidahitvā sumaṅgalaṃ nāma uyyānapālaṃ veyyāvaccakaraṃ katvā nagaraṃ pāvisi.
Paccekabuddho tato paṭṭhāya nibaddhaṃ rājagehe bhuñjanto tattha ciraṃ vasi, sumaṅgalopi naṃ sakkaccaṃ upaṭṭhahi.

after.title: [420] 4. Sumaṅgalajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Athekadivasaṃ paccekabuddho sumaṅgalaṃ āmantetvā “ahaṃ katipāhaṃ asukagāmaṃ nissāya vasitvā āgacchissāmi, rañño ārocehī”ti vatvā pakkāmi.
Paccekabuddho katipāhaṃ tattha vasitvā sāyaṃ sūriye atthaṅgate taṃ uyyānaṃ paccāgami.
Sumaṅgalo tassa āgatabhāvaṃ ajānanto attano gehaṃ agamāsi.
Paccekabuddhopi pattacīvaraṃ paṭisāmetvā thokaṃ caṅkamitvā pāsāṇaphalake nisīdi.
Taṃ divasaṃ pana uyyānapālassa gharaṃ pāhunakā āgamiṃsu.
So tesaṃ sūpabyañjanatthāya “uyyāne abhayaladdhaṃ migaṃ māressāmī”ti dhanuṃ ādāya uyyānaṃ gantvā migaṃ upadhārento paccekabuddhaṃ disvā “mahāmigo bhavissatī”ti saññāya saraṃ sannayhitvā vijjhi.

So saṃvegappatto vanditvā “bhante, ahaṃ tumhākaṃ āgatabhāvaṃ ajānanto ‘migo’ti saññāya vijjhiṃ, khamatha me”ti vatvā “hotu dāni kiṃ karissasi, ehi saraṃ luñcitvā gaṇhāhī”ti vutte vanditvā saraṃ luñci, mahatī vedanā uppajji.
Uyyānapālo “sace rājā jānissati, nāsessatī”ti puttadāraṃ gahetvā tatova palāyi.
Tāvadeva “paccekabuddho parinibbuto”ti devatānubhāvena sakalanagaraṃ ekakolāhalaṃ jātaṃ.

after.title: [420] 4. Sumaṅgalajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Punadivase manussā uyyānaṃ gantvā paccekabuddhaṃ disvā “uyyānapālo paccekabuddhaṃ māretvā palāto”ti rañño kathayiṃsu.
Rājā mahantena parivārena uyyānaṃ gantvā sattāhaṃ sarīrapūjaṃ katvā mahantena sakkārena jhāpetvā dhātuyo ādāya cetiyaṃ katvā taṃ pūjento dhammena rajjaṃ kāresi.
Sumaṅgalopi ekasaṃvaccharaṃ vītināmetvā “rañño cittaṃ jānissāmī”ti āgantvā ekaṃ amaccaṃ passitvā “mayi rañño cittaṃ jānāhī”ti āha.
Amaccopi rañño santikaṃ gantvā tassa guṇaṃ kathesi.
Puna kiñci avatvā rañño anattamanabhāvaṃ sumaṅgalassa kathesi.
So dutiyasaṃvaccharepi āgantvā tatheva rājā tuṇhī ahosi.
Amacco rañño cittamudubhāvaṃ ñatvā taṃ rājadvāre ṭhapetvā tassāgatabhāvaṃ rañño kathesi.
Rājā taṃ pakkosāpetvā paṭisanthāraṃ katvā “sumaṅgala, kasmā tayā mama puññakkhettaṃ paccekabuddho mārito”ti pucchi.
So “nāhaṃ, deva, ‘paccekabuddhaṃ māremī’ti māresiṃ, apica kho iminā nāma kāraṇena idaṃ nāma akāsi”nti taṃ pavattiṃ ācikkhi.
Atha naṃ rājā “tena hi mā bhāyī”ti samassāsetvā puna uyyānapālameva akāsi.

after.title: [420] 4. Sumaṅgalajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Atha naṃ so amacco pucchi “deva, kasmā tumhe dve vāre sumaṅgalassa guṇaṃ sutvāpi kiñci na kathayittha, kasmā pana tatiyavāre sutvā taṃ pakkositvā anukampitthā”ti?

Rājā “tāta, raññā nāma kuddhena sahasā kiñci kātuṃ na vaṭṭati, tenāhaṃ pubbe tuṇhī hutvā tatiyavāre sumaṅgale mama cittassa mudubhāvaṃ ñatvā taṃ pakkosāpesi”nti rājavattaṃ kathento imā gāthā āha – 27.

after.title: [420] 4. Sumaṅgalajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: “Bhusamhi kuddhoti avekkhiyāna, na tāva daṇḍaṃ paṇayeyya issaro;

after.title: [420] 4. Sumaṅgalajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Aṭṭhānaso appatirūpamattano, parassa dukkhāni bhusaṃ udīraye. 28.

after.title: [420] 4. Sumaṅgalajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: “Yato ca jāneyya pasādamattano, atthaṃ niyuñjeyya parassa dukkaṭaṃ;

after.title: [420] 4. Sumaṅgalajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Tadāyamatthoti sayaṃ avekkhiya, athassa daṇḍaṃ sadisaṃ nivesaye. 29.

after.title: [420] 4. Sumaṅgalajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: “Na cāpi jhāpeti paraṃ na attanaṃ, amucchito yo nayate nayānayaṃ;

after.title: [420] 4. Sumaṅgalajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Yo daṇḍadhāro bhavatīdha issaro, sa vaṇṇagutto siriyā na dhaṃsati. 30.

after.title: [420] 4. Sumaṅgalajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: “Ye khattiyā se anisammakārino, paṇenti daṇḍaṃ sahasā pamucchitā;

after.title: [420] 4. Sumaṅgalajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Avaṇṇasaṃyutā jahanti jīvitaṃ, ito vimuttāpi ca yanti duggatiṃ. 31.

after.title: [420] 4. Sumaṅgalajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: “Dhamme ca ye ariyappavedite ratā, anuttarā te vacasā manasā kammunā ca;

after.title: [420] 4. Sumaṅgalajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Te santisoraccasamādhisaṇṭhitā, vajanti lokaṃ dubhayaṃ tathāvidhā. 32.

after.title: [420] 4. Sumaṅgalajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Nisedhayanto janataṃ tathāvidhaṃ, paṇemi daṇḍaṃ anukampa yoniso”ti.

after.title: [420] 4. Sumaṅgalajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – tāta, pathavissaro rājā nāma “ahaṃ bhusaṃ kuddho balavakodhābhibhūto”ti ñatvā aṭṭhavatthukādibhedaṃ daṇḍaṃ parassa na paṇayeyya na vatteyya.
Kuddho hi aṭṭhavatthukaṃ soḷasavatthukaṃ katvā aṭṭhānena akāraṇena attano rājabhāvassa ananurūpaṃ “imaṃ ettakaṃ nāma āharatha, idañca tassa karothā”ti parassa bhusaṃ dukkhāni balavadukkhāni udīraye.

after.title: [420] 4. Sumaṅgalajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – yadā pana rājā parasmiṃ uppannaṃ attano pasādaṃ jāneyya, atha parassa dukkaṭaṃ atthaṃ niyuñjeyya upaparikkheyya, tadā evaṃ niyuñjanto “ayaṃ nāmettha attho, ayaṃ etassa doso”ti sayaṃ attapaccakkhaṃ katvā athassa aparādhakārakassa aṭṭhavatthukahetu aṭṭheva, soḷasavatthukahetu soḷaseva kahāpaṇe gaṇhamāno daṇḍaṃ sadisaṃ katadosānurūpaṃ nivesaye ṭhapeyya pavatteyyāti.

after.title: [420] 4. Sumaṅgalajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Amucchitoti chandādīhi agatikilesehi amucchito anabhibhūto hutvā yo nayānayaṃ nayate upaparikkhati, so neva paraṃ jhāpeti, na attānaṃ.
Chandādivasena hi ahetukaṃ daṇḍaṃ pavattento parampi tena daṇḍena jhāpeti dahati pīḷeti, attānampi tatonidānena pāpena.
Ayaṃ pana na paraṃ jhāpeti, na attānaṃ.
Yo daṇḍadhāro bhavatīdha issaroti yo idha pathavissaro rājā idha sattaloke dosānucchavikaṃ daṇḍaṃ pavattento daṇḍadhāro hoti.
Sa vaṇṇaguttoti guṇavaṇṇena ceva yasavaṇṇena ca gutto rakkhito siriyā na dhaṃsati na parihāyati.
Avaṇṇasaṃyutā jahantīti adhammikā lolarājāno avaṇṇena yuttā hutvā jīvitaṃ jahanti.
attano sāminiṃ puññalakkhaṇaṃ deviṃ ābharaṇaṃ yācīti attano sāmibhūtaṃ puññalakkhaṇasampannaṃ kosalarañño ekaṃ deviṃ ābharaṇaṃ yāci.
manamhi ajja imaṃ ābharaṇaṃ nissāya matāti ajja imaṃ ābharaṇaṃ nissāya manaṃ matā.
maraṇassa atisamīpatāya kiñci thokaṃ matā amhīti attho.
sahassena rattiṃ gacchantīti sahassapamāṇena dhanena rattibhāge nāgarā gacchanti.
sahassa mūlaṃ datvā kilesāturā manussā gacchantīti vuttaṃ hoti.
tattha tattha gumbaṃ ṭhapāpetvāti tasmiṃ tasmiṃ ṭhāne yodhe gumbaṃ gumbaṃ ṭhapāpetvā.
imaṃ coroti gahitapurisanti coroti nāgarehi kathitaṃ imaṃ purisaṃ mocetuṃ sace sakkhissāmi.
nagaraguttikassa sahassaṃ pesetvāti nagare guttikassa santikaṃ sahassaṃ pesetvā.
tiṇṇaṃ catunnaṃ divasamāsānaṃ accayenāti ettha kiñcāpi ekoyeva attho sambhavati.
vacanānaṃ pana alaṅkāratthaṃ yugalavasena tiṇṇaṃ catunnaṃ divasānanti vuttaṃ.
tadā rājā purisehi niyyamāno ahaṃ asukapabbatamatthake rukkhadevatāya balikammaṃ paṭissuṇaṃ.
sā balikammaṃ alabhamānā bhāyāmīti sā rukkhadevatāya balikammaṃ alabhamānatāya ahaṃ bhāyāmi.
aññaṃ purisaṃ na olokemīti aññaṃ purisaṃ kilesavasena na olokemi.
tenāha — “kāyuranti gīvāya piḷandhanapasādhanaṃ kāyura”nti. mahājanamajjhe sāvetvāti videsaṃ maṃ ānetvā tasmiṃ dese mahājanamajjhe ayaṃ mama dāsīti sāvetvā dāsī katvā gaṇhāti attho.
na cāhaṃ abhijānāmīti ahaṃ tava dhanaṃ ābhataṃ dhanassa āharaṇaṃ neva jānāmīti attho.
taṅkhaṇuppattiñāṇena bhayato parimmocanupāyaṃ jānitvāti vuttaṃ hoti.
pāḷiyaṃ yato sarāmi attānanti yato paṭṭhāya attānaṃ sarāmi.
yato pattāsmi viññutanti yato paṭṭhāya viññutaṃ pattā asmi.
sattuko tassādhippāyaṃ ajānantoti sattuko tassā sulasāya “na hi dāni puna atthi.
tena sabbesu ṭhānesu purisoyeva paṇḍito na hi hoti.
tattha tattha vicakkhaṇātipadaṃ pana purimavikappe viyojetabbaṃ.
na hi sabbesu ṭhānesu puriso hoti paṇḍito.
khippañcāti ettha karaṇatthe paccattavacanaṃ ca-saddo ca evatthoti āha “khippañcāti acirenevā”ti.
sattukā sulasā muñcatiiva sattusambādhā muccateti sambandhoti.
ettha ca kiñcāpi “na hi sabbesu ṭhānesū”ti ādi dve gāthāyo bhavanti.
atthassa pana yebhu-yyena anānattā ekagāthābhāvena gaṇetvā aṭṭhakanipāte saṅgahitanti.
